snippet.title: Khnum Fire Trailer 1 #KhnumFire
snippet.description:
ANUBIS NEEDS YOUR HELP!!! Amit, his best friend, woke up one day and decided to conquer the world. She took over his temple, and now she is feeding on the souls of the Duat. Anubis called for you, the Host of the God Khnum to help him. HURRY! There is NO TIME!



Download The DEMO:
https://tweekosowy.itch.io/khnum-fire-demo



This is my End of Studies Project, and I have worked so hard on it. It's honestly one of my biggest accomplishments in life so far, and I am so happy to be able to finally share it with the world.

It's a game of adventure and fantasy; it has two different combat systems (Magic and Sword), where you might use one or the other or even both to finish the game. It also has puzzles to solve and traps to avoid.

I hope you enjoy playing it just as much as I enjoyed making it, and if you want to support me, you can donate here or subscribe to my Patreon, where I will be posting exclusive content about the game and information about any future games to come.



Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/khnumfire/

Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/user/about?u=23556030

The Original Trailer Song:
https://tunetank.com/track/3785-adventures-in-egypt/
